entities.name: PMID:10742707
observations: Randomized celiprolol versus placebo study in chronic heart failure; all participants completed 6 months of exercise training.
Celiprolol group insulin sensitivity index increased 33% (P<0.05) versus 17% (not significant) in controls; fasting HDL increase was greater with celiprolol.
Exercise increased HDL by 12% overall and HDL/total-cholesterol and HDL/LDL ratios by 15% and 16%; total cholesterol did not change.

entities.name: Celiprolol
observations: Vasodilating beta1-adrenoceptor antagonist tested at 200 mg once daily in chronic heart failure during a 6-month exercise program.

entities.name: Chronic heart failure
observations: Population studied in the celiprolol plus exercise randomized trial.
